narrative.overview: A compact editorial career record. A two-line name and large blue career-focus links create a stronger first screen. Open grids organize experience, technical foundation and education; all four project covers use an identical soft-blue mat, image window and caption. Facts, local fonts, palette, CV and destinations remain unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Geometric display type with calm, readable body text.
Warm paper surfaces, navy contrast and restrained blue actions.
Open columns and fine rules for factual records.
Consistent rounded project frames with equal media heights.
Visible keyboard focus and restrained, reduced-motion-aware states.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actions, focus, active navigation and selected factual labels. Keep body copy and large page fields in the paper-and-navy family.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Space Grotesk for display hierarchy and IBM Plex Sans for reading and metadata; preserve their sans-serif fallbacks.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate adjacent content with tone, whitespace or a fine rule; keep the shipped surfaces and interaction states shadow-free.

dos: Do preserve the warm-paper, navy and restrained-blue palette and the two established font families.
Do use fine rules, clear labels and open spacing to organize factual content.
Do keep every project in the same card structure with equal media heights at each breakpoint.
Do keep keyboard focus visible, mobile controls reachable and content available without JavaScript.
Do preserve the distinction between work experience, training and familiarity when styling records.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent family or replace the locally hosted type pairing.
Don't add shadows or decorative motion to the recorded flat surfaces.
Don't make information depend on scrolling animations, hover or an unopened mobile menu.
Don't treat ordinary technology names as selectable chips when no selection behavior exists.
